rationale: The agent did not meet key policy requirements. Although it looked up the user and order, there’s no evidence of proper user authentication beyond an email lookup, and no explicit confirmation from the user before executing a write action. The tool call return_delivered_order_items was performed without first confirming the specific items (especially excluding the coffee machine) and without user approval, violating the confirm-before-write rule. It’s also not shown that the agent verified the order belonged to the authenticated user. Finally, the agent provided no final, concrete information about what was returned, refund details, or next steps—only a generic closing. These issues constitute a failure under the policy’s pass bar.
